method: Exact complete source excerpt and mapped node span continuity; CP287 row/node/scope mapping, CP292 complement checked, exact CP301 remaining owner ID subset, disjoint from independently read prior CP293–301 and earlier staged scopes.

groups.title: E parent stop delegate
groups.meaning: Absent detector or caught AttributeError/TypeError/ValueError null pair; call authoritative parent_stop (may search); null result null; int index bounds and main timestamp plus native event. Unpack/conversion outside catch.

groups.title: S A stop delegate
groups.meaning: Absent detector null; first_a_stop with Decimal price and native A confirmation; catches AttributeError/IndexError/TypeError/ValueError; null result null; preserve native main/event. Native fallback may use main candle when no lower rows.

groups.title: Behavior stop
groups.meaning: Spread proof/horizon stop view and add price string; no new stop search.

groups.title: Blue formation
groups.meaning: Non-scale (lowercased) source time and null event; scale 1-based reaction ordinal and valid Break bounds; native Break timestamp and confirmation with intrabar-start false.

groups.title: Reaction first identity
groups.meaning: Raw First/Break int indices without local bounds, native first color/time, direction label and public mode.

groups.title: Reaction geometry
groups.meaning: Public box times/prices; raw Break time and raw candidate confirmation with default intrabar flag; no geometry re-selection.

groups.title: Reset
groups.meaning: Bounded previous reaction First lookup; direct display/second times without strict/horizon guard here; broken level string.

groups.title: Blue projection
groups.meaning: Lowercased scale/reset mapping, unknown null; exact price/source extreme; stop main/event always null (no standalone retained evidence), source extreme as stop price; reset-only brokenLevel.

groups.title: Blue full ordinal
groups.meaning: Stable sort by int reaction number, source_time, str(kind), enumerate from one; full rather than visible list.
